name: zcode-rtl
description: Persian RTL fix for the ZCode Desktop chat UI (tested through 3.17.x). The Plugin Management toggle is a LIVE master switch (a background heartbeat applies/strips the fix in real time, and always runs the currently installed payload — a plugin refresh takes effect without killing the daemon). Stale RTL styles on streamed English paragraphs self-heal; launch shortcuts (desktop, Start Menu, taskbar search) stay flagged so the app opens with the debug port — no restart needed. Falls back to /rtl-fix on|off. Survives app updates — no app file is modified.
